lines.369680624604753921: I remember you. We spoke on the phone. The motel.
lines.369680624604753922: I was hoping you'd show up. Did you find what you were looking for?
lines.369680624608948224: I don't think I'm quite done yet. I still have questions.
lines.369680624608948225: You'll always have questions. There are lots of ways to skin a cat.
lines.369680624613142529: Just water for me. I don't drink anymore.
lines.369680624613142530: But you used to. Up on that stage, slurring the words by the end of a show.
lines.369680624613142531: Looking out into the audience for any girls who looked young enough. Eager enough.
lines.369680624617336832: I think you're confusing me with someone else.
lines.369680624617336833: You'd fall into them hoping that something would happen, that you'd come alive even for a second and that some great purpose would reveal itself.
lines.369680624617336835: It never worked, did it? Until she came along. Like a moth to a flame.
lines.369680624621531136: Not sure who was the moth and who was the flame.
lines.369680624621531137: Excuse me, but what the hell are you talking about? I'm Red Walker, I'm a private investigator.
lines.369680624621531138: I don't blame you, darling. No one can know the future. We all try to guess it, and still get surprised by what was waiting for us.
lines.369680624621531139: Like we didn't suspect what was coming, even though it should have been obvious from the start.
lines.369680624625725440: How else can we live? If we knew all along what's in store for us, would we even bother with it?
lines.369680624625725443: You stumble through it, like the rest of us. And that's all right.
lines.369680624629919744: That's the way it should be.
lines.369680624655085568: I'm happy we had this talk. Maybe something good will come out of it.
lines.369680624655085569: You're saying I have to let go... of everything.
lines.369680624655085570: There's no rush. You can stick around a little while longer if you wish. It won't hurt.
lines.369680624659279874: What's going to happen to you?
lines.369680624659279875: I'll be all right. I'm right where I'm supposed to be.
lines.369680624709611521: Hello, uh, my name is Red Walker and I’m calling from Silver Pines.
lines.369680624713805825: Can you hear me? My name is Red Walker.
lines.369680624713805826: Hey Marie, can you hear anything here? Do you think there’s something wrong with this headset?
lines.369680624713805827: I hear you, let me repeat…
lines.369680624722194433: Hey, I just called but it seems like there was something wrong with the line.
lines.369680624722194434: It’s the creepy prank caller again… Sir, you have to stop calling here, you are holding up the line for real emergencies.
lines.369680624722194435: I will have to block this number.
lines.369680624764137472: Hello, you’ve reached the tip line for CONMAG.
lines.369680624764137473: We want to hear your story about the unexplained or the supernatural.
lines.369680624764137474: ESP, UFO’s, government coverups, anything THEY wouldn’t want us to know about.
lines.369680624772526080: Share your statement and contact information after the beep. We are listening.
